title: Verbum: Minimalist Reading Companion
description: A stripped-down digital reading canvas engineered to eliminate cognitive friction. Features adaptive typographic scales, phonetic lookup overlays, and client-side privacy-first storage.

title: 12 Tenses Interactive Grammar Matrix
description: Reconceptualizing English verb tenses not as arbitrary memorization lists, but as a two-dimensional timeline coordinate plane (Time × Aspect). Adopted by over 40 language educators.

title: Thai-English Tech Terminology Lexicon
description: A contextual concordance mapping tricky technical jargon (idempotence, polymorphism, race condition) into precise Thai explanations with phonetic stress notes and live code examples.

title: Minimalist Desk Space Architecture
description: An experiential investigation into cognitive load and physical spatial constraints. Detailing how material curation, light angles, and analog writing stations dramatically boost intellectual stamina.
